coefficient.name: transient climate response to cumulative CO2 emissions

relationships.interpretation: Every additional tonne of net anthropogenic CO2 adds to warming. Stabilizing CO2-caused warming requires net-zero anthropogenic CO2 emissions.

relationships.limitation: AGGI covers long-lived gases and is not a complete climate projection; aerosols, solar forcing, surface albedo, feedbacks, and other agents must be included in attribution and projection models.

relationships.warning: Both series trend and are autocorrelated. The dashboard must show the raw correlation only beside the physical attribution chain and a first-difference diagnostic.

relationships.dashboard_rule: Use atmospheric abundance and gas-specific forcing for the physical chart. Use AR6-GWP100 CO2e only for the separate emissions-accounting chart.

baseline_rule: Temperature anomalies may be shifted between baselines only with a documented source-derived offset. This package preserves NASA 1951-1980 and NOAA 1971-2000 native baselines; correlation is invariant to a constant shift.
annual_threshold_rule: An individual year above 1.5 C does not mean the Paris long-term warming limit has been crossed; use a sustained multi-decadal global warming level for impact ladders.
